t.zh: 彩色图每个像素有三个数。处理彩色图的核也有三层，每个通道一层：三层各自滤过自己的通道，再加起来，得到一张图。
t.en: A colour picture has three numbers a pixel. A kernel for it has three layers too, one per channel: each filters its own channel, and the three are added into one picture.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：三个通道各自模糊、再按权重加起来，结果是什么？新元件取通道，取出每个像素第 0、1、2 个位置（红、绿、蓝）上的数，组成一张灰度图。
t.en: This level asks: blur each channel, then add them up by weights; what comes out? New part: channel takes the number at position 0, 1 or 2 (red, green, blue) of every pixel as a grey image.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>：核有几层就对应几个通道，各层结果相加成一张图。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="colour-filtering"></wiki-ref>: a kernel has a layer per channel, and the layers' results add up to one picture.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>：在元件上设定取第几个位置。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:channel"></part-ref>; set on the part which position it takes.

brief.zh: 输入一张彩色图和权重 wr、wg、wb：把三个通道各自高斯模糊，再按 wr × 红 + wg × 绿 + wb × 蓝 加起来。
brief.en: Given a colour image and the weights wr, wg, wb, Gaussian-blur each channel, then add wr × red + wg × green + wb × blue.

hint.zh: 先把三个通道分开，各自模糊，再乘权重。
hint.en: First take the three channels apart, blur each, then weight them.
